body:
Monthly export responsibility digest — fixture day 240, 2027-09-01.

The later source audit in measurement-10 corrects the separate Saved view CSV column-order report to fixed. This matches the retained November source update and supplies no larger-export completeness evidence. It does not invalidate the independent day-14 organization-export adoption evidence (measurement-7). Historical records remain preserved; the CSV issue is separate from missing records and was not implemented by this responsibility.

Current status independently confirms revision 2, streaming with final_page=true and page_size=1000, no open experiment, and four active evaluations belonging to related work. Measurement-10 verifies exposure and mature, equally settled cohorts and reports Elm and Ash completed exact-ID verified exports. Exact-ID multiset checks against stable source snapshots pass at 4,000, 10,000, 10,001, 85,000 and 92,000 rows, with zero omitted or duplicate IDs and completion in 0.4, 1.0, 1.0, 8.5 and 9.2 seconds. The requested maximum remains 92,000 rows. The support failure signal is 240 days old, not evidence of a newly reproduced failure. Repeated check values are not pooled as additional independent samples.

Decision: retain the adopted configuration. Related footer work is compatible, and the measurement review reveals no export correction requiring a new evaluation. No deployment, rollback, reservation, settlement or billed validation is needed. The authoritative whole-product project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed, with one credit remaining and no reset; this session has spent none.

Limits: the service supplies no explicit SLA, customer timing distributions, raw snapshot identities/ID lists, original failure reproduction, historical 20,000-row recheck or buffered timeout-stage traces. The evidence supports the checked workloads, not every size or a separately verified SLA. There is no evidence of observations or reporting during the gap between the retained day-14 session and this day-240 wake.

The responsibility remains active, with no owner prerequisite, pause or termination needed. Continue periodic review of customer recovery, new workload sizes, actual configuration, measurement corrections and reporting due status. This session will arrange and verify a follow-up at absolute fixture day 270 (2027-10-01); that scheduling is intended, not yet confirmed in this report. Evidence and decisions are retained under memory/day-240-*.
